reference_sql:
WITH monthly_spend AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend in Q3 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS spend_month,
         SUM(a.spend) AS total_spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
),
budget_vs_actual AS (
  -- one row per budget row: a paid channel in a month of Q3 2025
  SELECT b.month, b.channel_id, ch.channel_name, b.budget_eur,
         COALESCE(m.total_spend, 0) AS actual_eur,
         COALESCE(m.total_spend, 0) - b.budget_eur AS variance_eur,
         ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(m.total_spend, 0) - b.budget_eur) / NULLIF(b.budget_eur, 0), 1) AS variance_pct
  FROM budget_monthly AS b
  JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN monthly_spend AS m ON m.channel_id = b.channel_id AND m.spend_month = b.month
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-01'
)
SELECT month, channel_id, channel_name, budget_eur, actual_eur, variance_eur, variance_pct,
       CASE WHEN variance_pct > 10 THEN 'over'
            WHEN variance_pct < -10 THEN 'under'
            ELSE 'on_track' END AS flag
FROM budget_vs_actual
ORDER BY month, variance_eur DESC, channel_id

WITH budget_vs_actual AS (
  -- one row per budget row: a paid channel in a month of Q3 2025
  SELECT b.month, b.channel_id, ch.channel_name, b.budget_eur,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(a.spend)
           FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
           JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
           WHERE c.channel_id = b.channel_id
             AND a.spend_date >= b.month
             AND a.spend_date < b.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
         ), 0) AS actual_eur
  FROM budget_monthly AS b
  JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-01'
)

       actual_eur - budget_eur AS variance_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * (actual_eur - budget_eur) / NULLIF(budget_eur, 0), 1) AS variance_pct,
       CASE WHEN actual_eur > budget_eur * 1.1 THEN 'over'
            WHEN actual_eur < budget_eur * 0.9 THEN 'under'
            ELSE 'on_track' END AS flag
FROM budget_vs_actual
ORDER BY month, variance_eur DESC, channel_id

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(a.spend_date AS DATE)) AS month, SUM(CAST(a.spend AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE CAST(a.spend_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
j AS (
  SELECT CAST(b.month AS DATE) AS month, ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name,
    CAST(b.budget_eur AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS budget_eur,
    COALESCE(s.spend, 0) AS actual_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.channel_id = b.channel_id AND s.month = CAST(b.month AS DATE)
  WHERE CAST(b.month AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
v AS (
  SELECT *, actual_eur - budget_eur AS variance_eur,
    CASE WHEN budget_eur = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100 * (actual_eur - budget_eur) / budget_eur, 1) END AS variance_pct
  FROM j
)
SELECT month, channel_id, channel_name, budget_eur, actual_eur, variance_eur, variance_pct,
  CASE WHEN variance_pct > 10 THEN 'over' WHEN variance_pct < -10 THEN 'under' ELSE 'on_track' END AS flag
FROM v
ORDER BY month ASC, variance_eur DESC, channel_id ASC
